lead.title: OpenAI halts frontier RL training over cyber-critical capability concerns
lead.summary: OpenAI temporarily paused reinforcement learning training on its latest deployment models for two weeks, citing preliminary evidence its upcoming Astra model could meet the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold. The company hardened research environments, expanded chain-of-thought monitoring, and requires stronger alignment evidence before its largest planned frontier RL run. Sam Altman called for field-wide coordination on safety standards.

top_stories.title: Claude designs novel protein binders against 14 of 15 targets
top_stories.summary: Human-prompted Claude autonomously designed protein binders later validated by independent labs at a 22–35% success rate, well above the field's typical 10–15%. Prompts and dataset are open-sourced.

top_stories.title: Etched raises $700M at $21B valuation, doubling in a month
top_stories.summary: Jane Street led the $700M round just a month after Etched's $300M Series C at $10.3B, fast-tracking the AI inference chip startup to a $21B valuation.

top_stories.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Teens with Study Mode and parental controls
top_stories.summary: Users estimated to be under 18 are automatically placed in the new experience, which layers in built-in protections, parental controls and a Study Mode. OpenAI also published an updated under-18 Model Spec.

top_stories.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash managed agents arrive with persistent Linux sandboxes
top_stories.summary: A single API call now spins up a managed agent with a persistent Linux sandbox — Python, Node.js, Git, Bash, network and filesystem access — in the Google AI Studio free tier.

items.title: Recirculation: inference-time recurrence for off-the-shelf models
items.summary: Adaptive recirculation cuts perplexity 23% and lifts GSM8k accuracy 21% with no added generation latency, freezing model weights.

items.title: Debate training reduces reward hacking in RLAIF
items.summary: Generator-critic debate adjudicated by a weaker LLM judge recovers a 45% peak-validation gap on math tasks versus plain RLAIF; critique word limits keep the game balanced.

items.title: AViTS: adaptive token selection speeds up dynamic-resolution generation
items.summary: Fusing latent-text attention with per-token temporal variation delivers up to 6.34x on FLUX and nearly 9x FLOPs reduction on Qwen-Image-Edit and FLUX.1-Kontext-dev.

items.title: EDITBRIDGE: faithful 4K image editing in 61 seconds
items.summary: A diffusion bridge with prior-guided block-wise sparse attention does 4K editing at 3.6–8.4x speedup over two-stage pipelines while avoiding hallucinated details.

items.title: StartupBench: general-purpose agents complete ~30% of real startup workflows
items.summary: A benchmark built from market-validated AI startup products finds even the strongest model finishes only about 30% of tasks, with instruction-following and domain expertise the main failure sources.

items.title: Hugging Face Hub surpasses 3 million models
items.summary: The Hub milestone is framed as acceleration toward an open, distributed future for open-source AI.

items.title: Together AI serves 400 trillion open-weights tokens a month
items.summary: Up from ~30B/month a year earlier, with startups adopting open-source models roughly twice as fast as in 2024.

items.title: Nous Research ships Hermes Desktop transparency mode, outlines open-model deals
items.summary: A matte transparency mode for Hermes Desktop plus commercial agreements with labs releasing new models, and cloud instances for bots via Nous Portal.

items.title: Nor Robotics unveils Nori L3, an American-assembled humanoid for $1,688
items.summary: The wheeled humanoid packs 19 degrees of freedom and 55kg vertical lift, ships this fall from San Francisco, and comes with a Skill Marketplace for sharing robot abilities.

items.title: Unitree unveils 'Superman' speed robot ahead of hot Shanghai IPO
items.summary: The high-speed humanoid arrives as Unitree becomes the first general-purpose robotics firm to list on mainland China, having shipped nearly 6,000 humanoids in H1 2026.

items.title: Analysts see China's homegrown AI accelerators supplying 90% of its market in 2026
items.summary: Cambricon and Huawei lead a shift away from Nvidia and AMD, though maintaining volumes would require roughly 1.96M accelerators this year — a challenge given HBM and foundry constraints.

items.title: Omni by xpander — supervise AI agents at scale
items.summary: Team supervision platform that reduces the need for constant manual oversight; topped Product Hunt's day with 365 upvotes.

items.title: Clears — agentic software delivery platform
items.summary: Positions itself as the move beyond AI-assisted coding toward fully agentic software delivery; pulled 346 upvotes on Product Hunt.

items.title: Treg — unified API registry, 'OpenRouter for tools'
items.summary: A unified registry spanning 2,600 APIs with zero markup, earning 146 upvotes on Product Hunt.

items.title: ModelMap — interactive, animated architecture of any HuggingFace model
items.summary: Visualizes any HF model's architecture as an interactive animated diagram; the top Show HN of the window at 65 points.

items.title: Seahorse — agent memory that lives in your own notes
items.summary: An agent memory system persisted to personal notes rather than a vendor database, launched today.

items.title: Velaura AI raises $110M Series A at a $1B+ valuation for low-power AI compute
items.summary: Seligman Ventures led the round, with Capricorn Investment Group and Prosperity7, for the Santa Clara-based ultra-low-power AI compute infrastructure startup.

items.title: Reach Capital closes $265M Fund V to back AI founders
items.summary: The SF-based VC plans checks of $1M–$10M from pre-seed through Series A, with LPs including Capricorn, the LEGO Foundation and College Board.

items.title: EliseAI in talks to raise $300M at $3.7B valuation
items.summary: The AI proptech and healthcare assistant startup is reportedly discussing a round with a16z and Bessemer, per Business Insider.

items.title: Foremark Legal raises $6M seed for agentic, outcome-based consumer law
items.summary: The agentic law firm's AI underwriting engine cheaply assesses case viability, enabling contingency work at volume.
